description: Use when creating, reviewing, or styling charts, graphs, dashboards, sparklines, or any data visualization. Applies to Recharts, ECharts, Chart.js, matplotlib, Plotly, seaborn, D3.js, and SVG. Enforces Tufte principles (data-ink ratio, direct labeling, range-frame axes) plus modern screen-first standards (accessibility, responsive, dark mode).
